test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The efforts of the Government in providing health education and Primary Health Centres __**is borne**__ fruits.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** "have borne".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **subject **of the sentence, **"efforts**," is** plural.**
 
• Thus, the **verb** form** should also be plural**, hence **"have" instead** of "is" or "has".
 
• The past participle form **"borne"** is correctly used, which is the past participle of **"bear"** in the sense of producing or yielding something.

Therefore, the **sentence should **be: *"The efforts of the Government in providing health education and Primary Health Centres **have borne** fruits."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **"has borne" **would be correct if the subject of the sentence was singular.
 
• **"was bore" **is grammatically incorrect. The correct past participle of "bear" is "borne" when it means to produce or yield something, and "was" should not be used with "borne" in this context.
